desc: The Browning Citori 825 Nior Sporting over/under 12 gauge shotgun tailored for sporting clays and skeet competition. Features a AAAA maple stock with all new dark-stain finish; Fire Lite 2 Mechanical Trigger; Midas Grade Invector-DS choke tube system; HiViz Pro Comp sight; Inflex II recoil pad; gloss blued receiver with brushed sides and gold accents. Includes 5 extended Midas Grade choke tubes.
